description.ja: Figure-rise Standard 超サイヤ人3 孫悟空がパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！
description.en: Figure-rise Standard Super Saiyan 3 Son Goku is now available with a renewed package! !

description.ja: • ドラゴンボールZのラストで魔人ブウとの壮絶なバトルを繰り広げた超サイヤ人3孫悟空がFigure-rise Standardに登場！
description.en: • Super Saiyan 3 Son Goku, who fought a fierce battle with Majin Buu at the end of Dragon Ball Z, is now available in Figure-rise Standard!

description.ja: • 特徴的な大ボリュームの髪型、険しく迫力に満ちたフェイスを完全再現！
description.en: • The characteristic large volume hairstyle and rugged and powerful face are completely reproduced!

description.ja: • パーツを重ねあわせる構造で、瞳の細かな色分けまでも成形パーツで再現。ハイクオリティな完成度を実現！
description.en: • The structure allows the parts to overlap, and even the detailed color coding of the eyes is reproduced using molded parts. Achieving high quality perfection!

description.ja: • かめはめ波のエフェクトパーツや瞬間移動の手パーツが付属し、原作のさまざまなシーンを演出可能！
description.en: • Comes with Kamehameha effect parts and teleportation hand parts, allowing you to create various scenes from the original!

description.ja: • 同時発売のFigure-rise Standard魔人ブウ（純粋）と組み合わせて、感動のラストバトルを再現可能！
description.en: • In combination with the simultaneously released Figure-rise Standard Majin Buu (pure), you can recreate the thrilling final battle!

description.ja: • Figure-rise Standard「ドラゴンボール」シリーズを集めて、圧倒的バトルシーンを再現しよう！
description.en: • Collect Figure-rise Standard "Dragon Ball" series and recreate overwhelming battle scenes!
